svg.title: Orion: illustrative stellar proper motion
svg.desc: Four side-by-side panels illustrate the motion of nine points from a legacy classroom dataset at -100000, 0, +100000, and +500000 years. This is not a validated astronomical prediction.
svg.text: Nine legacy data points · fixed axis limits · linear projected displacement
Educational illustration only · unknown reference epoch and source catalogue · not a validated astronomical forecast
